recommendations: Inspiration Grant button disables on hardcoded `inspiration >= 1`. phase2_notes: Contract boundary (endpoints.ts/types.ts) matches HANDOFF-TO-FRONTEND-2026-06-14 field-for-field: paths, encodeURIComponent on resource key, DM-only grant, RAW-SET HP semantics documented.
HP math correct: handleDamage absorbs temp HP first then floors current at 0; handleHeal clamps to maxHp; set paths send absolute, server clamps.
Double-submit guarded by `busy` flag disabling all controls during a mutation (addresses the stale-closure note in CLAUDE.md).
Auth surfaces align with backend: Sheet button + canManage = isDm || ownerId===userId; grantInspiration = isDm only. Backend 404s/enforces regardless (advisory UX).
